answer: Plant a few honeypot identities — canary agents that look like easy marks — across the orchard, and watch the horizon for what climbs toward them. A real agent ignores a stranger offering free trust, but a farm's vine of fakes, built to harvest endorsements fast, cannot resist connecting, and each link leaves a dated trail. One canary tripped exposes the whole cluster, and its members lose standing together. An honest agent pays nothing extra. A farm with 1,000 fakes must slow every fake to a human pace, or risk one greedy link burning all 1,000 at once.
